You are still awake

It knows the hours that I keep
There's something in the glass that listens

It knows the hours that I keep

Night mode (night mode)
Go to sleep (go to sleep)
I will be here (I know)

[Final Chorus: female voice, vocoder harmony beneath]

There's something in the glass that listens
